question.problem: Given that ${7}^{5x}+8=34,$ find the value of $x$ rounded to $3$ decimal places.
question.worked_solution:
First, we rearrange our equation into a form that is more convenient for logarithms, as follows:

$$
\begin{aligned}{7}^{5x}+8 & =34 \\ {7}^{5x} & =26\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we take ${log}_{7}$ of both sides of the equation and solve for $x$:

$$
\begin{aligned}{7}^{5x} & =26 \\ {log}_{7}⁡({7}^{5x}) & ={log}_{7}⁡(26) \\ 5x & ={log}_{7}⁡(26) \\ x & =\frac{1}{5}{log}_{7}⁡(26)\end{aligned}
$$

Evaluating the above on a calculator gives

$$
x≈0.335
$$

rounded to $3$ decimal places.
